login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your company account (same as Windows)

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-step verification
mfaSetup.intro: Two-step verification is required to protect your account. Scan the code with Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
mfaSetup.step1: Open your authenticator app and add an account
mfaSetup.step2: Scan the code (or type the key manually)
mfaSetup.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

company.title: Choose a company
company.intro: Your account can access more than one company. Choose the one to work on.

noCompany.title: No access
noCompany.intro: Your account is verified but not linked to any company yet. Contact the system administrator.

home.intro: You are signed in. Modules will appear here as they are delivered.
home.noPermissions: Your account belongs to this company but has no role yet. Ask the company administrator for the access you need.

errors.validation_too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.validation_account_locked: The account is temporarily locked. Try again later.
errors.validation_directory_unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.validation_invalid_mfa_code: The verification code is wrong or expired.
errors.validation_not_a_member: You do not have access to this company.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
errors.session_expired: The sign-in step expired. Please start over.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
errors.validation_role_code_invalid: Code: letters, digits, - or _ only (up to 50).
errors.validation_role_name_invalid: Arabic and English names are required.
errors.conflict_role_code_taken: A role with this code already exists.
errors.not_found_member: User is not in this company.
errors.validation_user_not_in_directory: No such active user in Active Directory.
errors.validation_last_administrator: The company must keep at least one full administrator.
errors.validation_not_yourself: You cannot deactivate your own access.
errors.validation_beyond_own_permissions: You cannot grant permissions you do not have.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions given to users in this company.
roles.builtInAdmin: Built-in role: every permission, including any new module automatically. It cannot be changed.
roles.builtInReadOnly: Built-in role: every view permission, no changes. It cannot be changed.

users.title: Users
users.intro: People with access to this company and their roles.
users.addIntro: Enter the Active Directory user name. They join the company with no role; then choose their roles.
users.rolesIntro: Each role applies to all commercial registrations or to one (e.g. accountant for Care-Pro 05 only).
